archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-contract
archetypes.rationale: Plan-review prompt contracts are byte-sensitive despite prose compression.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed plan-review prompt rendering for parser-contract drift. Focus on TSV header, sentinel, focus-area allowlists, scope tags, and Cursor versus Codex plan handling. Check rendered output, not just source strings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
